title: Typing / in Ask lists the commands you can run
goal: In the Ask composer, typing / turns it into the command list the mock shows: every menu command by name, filtered as you type, and Return runs the one picked, so a sentence you ask and a command you run go through the same box. After a run, the Agent group lists what changed, and clicking a change picks that layer on the canvas.
notes: Left out of the first Ask slice (ask-in-the-app-runs-on-a-local-model-with-no-mod). Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/agent-generate-wt.html (#agentChanges, .askcmd .cplist in docs/design/mocks/shared/dist/photonz-ds.js askPalHTML). Commands: AppCommandTable (PhotonzCore) with EditorState.run(_:) and canRun. Composer: AskComposerOverlay in Sources/Photonz/Agent/AskViews.swift; Agent group: AgentPanel.
acceptance: In the Ask composer (title bar Ask button or Command K), typing / shows a filtered list of commands with their menu names, as the mock agent-generate-wt.html step 1 shows
Return or a click on a row runs that command on the document, one undo step, and the list closes
After Run Plan, the Agent group shows the mock's Last change rows (one per change, what changed and to what); clicking one picks that layer on the canvas and in Layers
A walk proves both with the pointer, at Next defaults
The composer stays up over the window after Ask, showing what was asked and the plan's state as the mock's chat does, without covering the Agent group's Run Plan (today it closes as soon as you ask)
